daily_thesis: The 2026-09-02 batch is about action permission under stale state and incomplete evidence. Geometry papers turn maps, scene graphs, and point-cloud registration into freshness contracts: VOIM delays semantic commitment, DSG and HitMem update dynamic 3D memory, On-the-Fly3R rejects inconsistent UAV views, and industrial bundle adjustment removes brittle correspondences before planning inherits the error. VLA and manipulation papers split action into typed motor programs, executable-skill preconditions, adaptive chunk stops, negation constraints, and future contact consequences. Driving and robot autonomy papers ask whether rare objects, partner communication, compression stages, and long-horizon risk should actually change the feasible action set. VLM and efficiency papers make the same demand at the evidence layer: verify the task, prove the visual cue was used, and spend extra tokens or bandwidth only when it changes the decision.

clusters.cluster: 3D maps move from accumulated geometry to freshness-gated action state
clusters.why: 기존 mapping 평가는 더 많은 관측을 누적하면 map이 좋아진다는 가정에 기대기 쉽다. VOIM은 첫 detection에서 label을 확정하는 순간이 가장 약하다고 보고 voxel evidence가 쌓일 때까지 semantic commitment를 미루며, DSG와 HitMem은 object displacement가 scene graph와 3D memory를 낡게 만드는 문제를 직접 다룬다. On-the-Fly3R과 correspondence-free bundle adjustment는 UAV나 산업 workcell처럼 입력 순서와 correspondence가 불안정한 곳에서 잘못된 view를 받아들이지 않는 장치를 둔다. APRL geometry 평가는 map quality가 아니라 stale label, view rejection, memory decay, correspondence ambiguity가 route, grasp, relocalization을 얼마나 바꾸는지로 설계해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Six papers independently expose deferred labels, dynamic scene graphs, stale 3D memory, UAV consistency checks, correspondence-free registration, and egocentric metric frames.
clusters.lab_action: Indoor ObjectNav, industrial scrap, UAV mapping, and egocentric manipulation scenes에서 label deferral, scene-graph update, memory decay, view rejection, and depth-map registration을 독립 ablation 축으로 두고 object relocation, route deviation, grasp-region error, relocalization success를 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: Driving autonomy shifts from recognizing rare cases to deciding whether action affordance changed

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: Late-August editions repeatedly emphasized robot-usable geometry, execution diagnosis, tactile/contact assets, and external release gates.
frontier_memory.body: September 2 strengthens that direction with dynamic 3D memory, correspondence-free industrial registration, typed VLA programs, contact-valued actions, and evidence-use diagnostics.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Recent VLA notes focused on adaptation eligibility and memory, but less on whether action chunks themselves know when to stop.
frontier_memory.body: Adaptive chunking and EmbodiedSkills make execution termination and prerequisite checking explicit variables rather than hidden runtime behavior.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: Visual token pruning and compression have appeared often in the last four weeks.
frontier_memory.body: The differentiator is now the retained decision-changing evidence: spatial coverage, coarse geometry, query-specific memory, and grounded speculative decoding.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: Geometry, VLA execution, and VLM evidence reliability are usually evaluated separately.
frontier_memory.body: APRL can own their intersection by testing whether stale maps, invalid visual evidence, and contact uncertainty jointly veto actions.

strategy_board.title: Dynamic 3D memory freshness suite
strategy_board.thesis: Make semantic maps, scene graphs, and temporal memory prove that each update remains usable after object motion, drift, and partial observation.
strategy_board.one_week: Build a small indoor and workcell probe with moved objects, stale labels, correspondence ambiguity, and known route or grasp consequences.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Build a small indoor and workcell probe with moved objects, stale labels, correspondence ambiguity, and known route or grasp consequences.

strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare voxel label deferral, dynamic scene graphs, temporal 3D memory, online UAV reconstruction checks, and depth-map registration on the same action outcomes.
strategy_board.success: At least one method ranking reverses when judged by relocation, grasp, or relocalization instead of map or segmentation quality alone.
strategy_board.success_metric: At least one method ranking reverses when judged by relocation, grasp, or relocalization instead of map or segmentation quality alone.
strategy_board.stop: If stale-state perturbations do not change downstream action, narrow the suite to dynamic indoor scene graphs only.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If stale-state perturbations do not change downstream action, narrow the suite to dynamic indoor scene graphs only.
